Name: Em's Iridium Sprinklers
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Recolouring of the iridium sprinklers. Making them stand out less, but still referring to the iridium ore.
This way, they fit better between the crops.

There are two options:
A wooden sprinkler with iridium nozzles.
A [i]pure[/i] iridium sprinkler. The colour matches the metal of the iridium pickaxe.

[i]Update 1.1: Added configuration possibility[/i]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9XxGzVQj/Nozzle.png[/img]
﻿This is a smaller/simpler mod, and only changes the iridium sprinkler
For more sprinkler options, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36790]Em's Sprinklers
[/url]This includes all sprinklers, Qi's sprinkler items and the option to turn the sprinklers into frogs

[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

[/b]Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///][b]SMAPI[/b][/url][b] [/b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher
[/b][/url]Download and unzip "Em's Iridium Sprinklers"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default is set to the wooden sprinkler with iridium nozzles. To choose a different type:
Open and close the game once
There is now a [i]config.json[/i] file in the Sprinkler mod folder
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file, and simply type "[color=#e69138]Metal[/color]" instead of "[color=#e69138]Wood[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
